comments.author: Alex Kim
comments.body: Confirmed mapper has substring(0, 255) with a comment about legacy report width. Safe to drop for v2 export.

content.text: Confirmed mapper has substring(0, 255) with a comment about legacy report width. Safe to drop for v2 export.
Board and issue CSV exports cut multi-line description fields at 255 characters even when the source field holds several kilobytes. Single-line short descriptions export in full.
Full description text should appear in the CSV cell with embedded newlines escaped per RFC 4180. Importers downstream lose acceptance criteria and repro steps that live past the 255th character.

Export worker still applies a legacy VARCHAR(255) style truncate from the old MySQL report schema; the truncate happens in CsvRowMapper.mapDescription before quoting. Removing that cap or raising it to the same 32KB limit as the API would match product expectations.
